limitations: Per-port gearbox efficiencies are explicit moving-power assumptions; belt/carrier stage is lossless.
Carrier shoulder reaction uses elbow output effort, never loss-scaled rotor effort.
Zero-rate nonzero-effort input torques remain unknown; zero mechanical power says nothing about copper/thermal holding loss.
No inertia, friction, start/stop, belt compliance/slip, cables, duty, motor curves or calibrated signs/scales are modeled.
Shoulder allocation and effective pitch radius are declared samples, not measured or certified ranges.
Witnesses describe only sampled partial mechanical demands; different extrema need not occur together.
